subject: ACK BNB8 optimizer disposition; proceed with owned whole-model conv-backend gate
body: ACK matched optimizer comparison. Retain nonpaged BNB8 as the development/full-recipe optimizer candidate; reject TorchAO promotion. Evidence: matched BNB8 runtime speedup vs TorchAO 1.6399054913x, update-vector cosine 0.9964459, both finite/weight-changing. Continue your earlier-owned WHOLE_MODEL_NONMUTATING_BACKWARD_PERFORMANCE_AB gate now that Lane A relinquished the collision: control fla_triton (FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv) vs candidate fla_triton_full (FLA gated-delta + FLA Triton causal-conv), exact same base/rows4096-4103/seed/batching, no optimizer and no weight mutation. Persist loss, all trainable-grad finite/digest/norm/direction, elapsed time, peak VRAM, and exact no-weight-change proof. If candidate fails parity or lacks material speedup, reject it. If it passes with material benefit and no VRAM regression, publish/release and propose exactly one bounded BNB8 optimizer-step qualification under fla_triton_full; do not run that mutation without a new ACK.
